pageState.description: Read the current LinkedIn route, authentication gate, challenge, rate-limit, and hydration state.

searchState.description: Verify that LinkedIn reached the requested people, content, or company search route and report its result state.

result_type.description: Expected result type: people, content, companies, or all.

searchResults.description: Extract visible LinkedIn people, content, or company search results with canonical identity and preview assets.

result_type.description: Filter to people, content, companies, or all.

viewport_only.description: Only include results intersecting the viewport.

scrollResults.description: Scroll a LinkedIn search page by one bounded viewport step to hydrate more results.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

to_top.description: Reset the result page to the top.

profileDetail.description: Extract visible profile identity, relationship labels, landing-page history, and avatar for research.

returns.description: Visible LinkedIn profile details or an explicit gate state.

profileHistory.description: Extract complete visible work or education entries from a LinkedIn profile details route.

returns.description: Work or education entries from /in/<id>/details/experience/ or /details/education/.

companyDetail.description: Extract the active LinkedIn company landing-page identity, logo, follower count, and employee range.

returns.description: Visible LinkedIn company details or an explicit route state.

companyPeople.description: Extract profiles visibly listed in the company page's People you may know section without claiming they are employees.

limit.description: Maximum visible profile suggestions to return.

returns.description: Explicit route/gate state, associated-member count, and visible profile suggestions with their source section.

relatedPeople.description: Extract profiles from explicitly labelled related-people sections on the active profile or company page.

limit.description: Maximum visible related profiles to return.

returns.description: Explicit route/gate state and visible related profiles with their source-section label.

postDetail.description: Extract the active LinkedIn post, author, canonical identity, previewable media assets, and engagement metadata.

returns.description: Visible LinkedIn post details or an explicit gate state.

comments.description: Extract comments currently visible on the active LinkedIn post; never likes, replies, or submits anything.
